item.title: Dutch Court Recognizes Religious Tribunal Rulings in Family Law Cases
item.description: The Netherlands ruling grants formal standing to religious court decisions, with a sharia council among the recognized religious tribunals.

item.title: New Islamic Party Enters Parliament After Belgian Elections
item.description: The confessional bloc won seats in Belgium's federal parliament for the first time.

item.title: EU Opens Accession Talks Framework with Turkey
item.description: Brussels agreed to revisit EU membership discussions with Ankara under a new political integration roadmap.

item.title: Government Collapses in Austria as Coalition Splits
item.description: The Austrian coalition collapses after months of deadlock, forcing new elections.

item.title: Sharia Court Expansion Debated in Jakarta
item.description: Indonesian lawmakers discussed the role of religious courts in the provinces.
